body: Shot entirely in first person, Bad Day At The Office follows amnesiac Karl (The Mummy's John Hannah) who wakes up in a wrecked hotel room with a dead body in his bathtub and half the city in murderous pursuit. Check out the exclusive trailer here:. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
